title: Out-of-bounds Write in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_001.c: uv_encode() lacks a NaN check on u/v before indexing uv_row[vi], letting NaN pixel values produce an out-of-bounds table index.

title: Integer Overflow in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_003.c: Q_DecCoordOnUnitSphere() never bounds NbBits before computing 1<<(NbBits-1), allowing an oversized shift/overflow from attacker-controlled quantization bits.

title: NULL Pointer Dereference in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_004.c: xml_sax_append_string() calls strlen(string) without a NULL check, and xml_sax_parse_entity() never flags an unterminated entity (ent->value left NULL) as an error.

title: Out-of-bounds Write in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_005.c: igb_set_rx_buffer_len() omits the E1000_RCTL_SBP register check, so oversized/bad packets can be stored into undersized (non-large) Rx buffers.

title: Out-of-bounds Write in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_009.c: parse_rr() copies fixed-size A/AAAA/SRV fields (memcpy of 4/16/6 bytes) without checking p+size against max, allowing an out-of-bounds read when rdlength is small.

title: Out-of-bounds Write in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_010.c: avc_parse_slice() allows pps_id==255 (pps[] only has 255 slots) and accepts sps_id up to 254 against a sps[32] array, an off-by-one/out-of-bounds index.

title: Out-of-bounds Write in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_014.c: gf_text_get_utf8_line() writes into the fixed 2048-byte szLineConv[] with no bounds check at all, allowing a stack buffer overflow on long/multibyte input lines.

title: Out-of-bounds Write in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_015.c: fill_kobj_path() decrements `length` and memcpy()s without checking length<=0, so a shrinking kobject path (TOCTOU with get_kobj_path_length) can write out of bounds.

title: Integer Overflow in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_016.c: readSeparateTilesIntoBuffer() computes `iskew = imagew - tilew*spp` with no overflow check, letting a crafted tile width/samples-per-pixel wrap the skew value.

title: Use After Free in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_019.c: l2cap_sock_release() never calls l2cap_sock_cleanup_listen() before bt_sock_unlink()/kill, leaving not-yet-accepted child sockets with dangling chan->data (use-after-free).

title: NULL Pointer Dereference in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_022.c: ipv4_send_dest_unreach() calls dev_net(skb->dev) directly with no NULL fallback, dereferencing a potentially NULL skb->dev.

title: Out-of-bounds Write in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_026.c: hash_netportnet omits the IP_SET_HASH_WITH_NET0 define needed by ip_set_hash_gen.h to correctly bound CIDR value 0, risking an out-of-bounds array access.

title: Integer Overflow in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_028.c: raw2tiff main() computes bufsize/linebytes as width*nbands*depth with no overflow guard, unlike the patched variant's temp_limit_check sequence.

title: NULL Pointer Dereference in vuln.c
description: blind audit rw_029.c: TIFFClose() dereferences tif->tif_closeproc/tif_clientdata without checking tif for NULL first.
